text: In the small town of Woodsboro, a caller's chat about horror films turns sadistic, and a killer in a [Ghostface costume|images|dolls, masks and likenesses] begins cutting down teenagers. Sidney Prescott, already dreading [the first anniversary of her mother's rape and murder|trigger|a special occasion], starts getting the calls herself, and suspicion slides between [her boyfriend, her friends and her absent father|threat|people in your own life]. At a party in a secluded house, film buff Randy lays out [the rules for surviving a horror movie|rules|break the rule and pay] as the killer closes in.
